question: derive the director desk's conditional marker surface from structure, and measure how much of it the 15 measured open paths actually account for

method.instrument: walk the DOM for data-director-* in the same cell, before and after the open path; the difference is what the path brought in
method.whyNotAList: 643's surfaceOf and 626's PANELS are the failure mode: a hand-written list of what to measure is the one thing guaranteed to expire
method.gateAsPrecondition: 654's scroll_gate, so the diff is not measured through a scrolled lens

byTextInstead.note: same pattern, counted on raw text: it also matches code quoted inside docstrings, and it is what a quick grep gives

receivers: menu.get_by_role('button', name='未命名工作区', exact=True)
page.get_by_role('button', name='展开智能剪辑编辑器')
page.get_by_role('button', name='开启九宫格辅助线')
page.get_by_text('预设 - 图片高清', exact=False).first
second_item.get_by_role('button', name='选择截图 {} · 镜头-截图01'.format(camera_name))
census.howCounted: ast.Call on an .Attribute named click/hover, plus dispatch_event('click'); docstrings and comments are NOT counted

the-default-marker-surface-is-derived-an.note: derived by walking the DOM, not by reading a list

detail.why: the panels are not in the DOM until something is opened, so at the default state the pairing has nothing to pair with. This is why the census has to be a before/after diff, not a static list.

the-trigger-panel-pairing-heuristic-is-f.note: recorded so the next batch does not spend a run rediscovering it

every-open-path-actually-brings-in-at-le.note: an empty set is not evidence — it is the signature of a probe that did not do anything

the-conditional-surface-does-not-depend-.note: if the diff moved with the viewport, the surface would be a layout artefact rather than a set of things being brought in

no-hand-written-panel-selector-is-stale.note: 626's PANELS/OVERLAYS is the one hand-written list left; this is the test that would catch it going stale

detail.theMisreadingThatWasCorrected: the first draft called these 80 a 'coverage gap' and the fraction 0.158 read like a score. They are the INSIDE of the 15 panels 626/648 already censused — 648 counted live controls, not panel elements, so a marker that is not a panel root is not an untested thing.
detail.whatIsActuallyLeftOpen: nothing here. The real open question is whether some conditional surface exists OUTSIDE these 15 open paths, and this batch cannot answer that without trying more paths — which is the next batch, not a finding.

every-conditional-marker-is-owned-by-a-m.note: the owner map is what the next batch needs: it says which measured panel each un-named marker lives in

detail.note: the first version of this check asked the gate to stay silent on all fifteen. Two of them are 654's positives — a gate that stayed silent there would be broken, so the demand itself was wrong.
detail.whatTheGateCannotContaminateHere: this census reads WHICH attributes exist, not where anything is, so the scroll does not touch the reading. It would touch any geometry read taken after the same path — which is why the gate is still worth running.

654s-gate-re-names-exactly-its-own-two-p.note: a gate re-confirmed on a batch it was not built for is worth more than a gate re-run on its own set
